# AIR 903 BASE

Ultra-Cooling Mid-Tower with Max Capacity

​▲ A Mid-Tower Case Designed for both Air and Liquid Cooling

▲ 360mm Radiator Support at the Top and Front

▲ 180mm Height for a Top-Class Air cooler

▲ Innovative Mesh Front Panel for the Best Cooling Performance

▲ High-Performance HP140 PWM Fans

▲ Support for Vertical GPU Mounting

▲ Ample Space for Flagship 4090 Graphics Cards

▲ Spacious Cable Management routes

▲ USB TYPE-C Port and 2x USB3.0 Port

**Classic Reversion – Epic Evolution**

Introducing the Montech AIR 903 series - the ultimate upgrade for PC enthusiasts. It offers superior aesthetics, unparalleled airflow, meticulous attention to detail, and exceptional compatibility.

Get ready for the best mainstream case of 2023.

![](https://www.montechpc.com/images/default/loading.svg)

![](https://www.montechpc.com/images/default/loading.svg)

**Maximize Airflow, Optimize Performance**

Experience the innovative AIR 903 case with a metal front panel featuring a staggering 51% ventilation rate.

It maximizes airflow, delivering superior thermal performance and an ultimate gaming experience.

![](https://www.montechpc.com/images/default/loading.svg)

**Unleash the Ultimate Dust-Free Experience**

Enjoy optimal airflow, easy cleaning with the quick-release design, and comprehensive dustproof protection with strategically placed filters.

![](https://www.montechpc.com/images/default/loading.svg)

![](https://www.montechpc.com/images/default/loading.svg)

**Limitless Cooling Potential and Customization Freedom**

Offers maximum airflow and versatility with a generous clearance for CPU tower coolers, support for 360mm AIO coolers at the front and top, and the ability to install up to 9 fans.

![](https://www.montechpc.com/images/default/loading.svg)

![](https://www.montechpc.com/images/default/loading.svg)

![](https://www.montechpc.com/images/default/loading.svg)

**Seamless Fit for Massive GPUs and Unparalleled PSU Clearance**

Offers unrivaled graphics card compatibility, accommodating massive GPUs up to 400mm in length and 190mm in width, including popular models like the NVIDIA® GeForce RTX® 40 series with ease.

![](https://www.montechpc.com/images/default/loading.svg)

**True E-ATX Compatibility and Seamless Installation**

Supports E-ATX and SSI-EEB form factors, providing a seamless installation experience with pre-punched mounting holes and cable routing holes.

![](https://www.montechpc.com/images/default/loading.svg)

![](https://www.montechpc.com/images/default/loading.svg)

![](https://www.montechpc.com/images/default/loading.svg)

**Clean and Tangle-Free Cable Routing**

Features a spacious 27mm cable route, rubber grommets, and Velcro straps for a hassle-free and organized interior.

![](https://www.montechpc.com/images/default/loading.svg)

**Vertical GPU Mounting Compatible**

Upgrade your gaming experience with the Montech Vertical Graphics Card Mounting Kit (sold separately). Remove all 7 PCIe slot covers for effortless installation and enjoy improved thermal performance and striking visuals by vertically mounting your graphics card. Elevate your GPU's aesthetics and performance like never before.

[\*Vertical GPU mounting kit: Click Here](https://www.montechpc.com/vgm2)

Premium case with a lots of premium features in budget price.

![](https://www.montechpc.com/images/default/loading.svg)

2023.06.26

Montech have stepped forward with a truly excellent budget friendly airflow chassis

![](https://www.montechpc.com/images/default/loading.svg)

KitGuru

High airflow, good cooling, extensive hardware support and water-cooing compatibility are all things we expect from expensive high-end cases but Montech offers all this in the AIR 903 Base while keeping the price firmly in the budget sector.

![](https://www.montechpc.com/images/default/loading.svg)

2023.07.19

GeekaWhat

It's really well done. I've got to say, I'm impressed.

![](https://www.montechpc.com/images/default/loading.svg)

2023.07.07

PC Mag

Air 903 Max is a fine value from a relatively new player in the budget case space, and a hearty “recommend.”

![](https://www.montechpc.com/images/default/loading.svg)

2024.10.20

Tom's Hardware

Montech’s Air 903 Max provides excellent thermal performance, with support for large motherboards and up to seven storage drives. What more could you ask for in a relatively low-priced PC case?
